transcript: If you feel like everything is stuck and abundance isn't coming, no matter how hard you try, you need to hear this. Take a handful of rice and a tablespoon of sugar. Before throwing them in the toilet, hold them in your closed hand and say silently, I release what blocks my path. I sweeten what comes to me. May abundance find space in my life. Throw them in the toilet and flush. Rice represents abundance. It's the most sacred food in ancient traditions. It symbolizes prosperity, nourishment and flow. Sugar sweetens the paths, softens what was bitter and attracts good things with ease. And water carries everything away. It drags away stagnation, dissolves blockages and makes way for the new. When the three come together, you're giving a symbolic command to your life. The old goes away and the good enters. Do it once a week, always with intention, never in a hurry and don't tell anyone while you're doing it. What you protect in silence works with more strength. Many people notice that after starting this things change. Deaths that get unstuck, opportunities that appear, unexpected money that arrives, as if something that was blocked had been released. Great abundance in the comments if you're going to do it today. But I want you to understand something. Rituals move energy from outside. But if inside you still lives the fear of money, anxiety about the future and a scarcity mindset that you've been dragging for years, abundance has nowhere to stay. Money doesn't flow toward fear, it flows toward calm. You can do all the rituals in the world, if inside you're still in lack, what arrives slips away. And if you want to release the fear that blocks your prosperity and live from calm so abundance stays.
